beats.text: He was nearly forty, with nothing to his name but a pack on his back.
John had left the army and crossed to Africa, with a Portuguese family driven out of their home.
beats.scene: A dark sixteenth-century harbour at dusk: a small wooden sailing ship with a patched sail rides at a stone quay under a hard moon, a ragged family of four adults and bundled belongings stand huddled at the water's edge seen from behind, among them a tall man in a faded cloak carrying a heavy bundle; skewed angular quayside buildings, drifting mist. No faces visible.

beats.text: They had lost everything, and he found work to feed them.
Then he came back to Gibraltar, on his confessor's advice.
beats.scene: The great dark rock of Gibraltar rising over a small walled harbour town at dawn, a hard light on the sheer cliff, mist on the water; on the stony shore in the foreground a single tiny traveller with a pack on his back, seen from far behind, walks toward the town gate. Painted theatrical set, skewed angular rooftops.

beats.text: He carried holy books and pictures from town to town, and sold them for almost nothing.
Tradition holds that a vision of the Infant Jesus came to him, and called him John of God.
Tradition holds, too, that it sent him to Granada.
beats.scene: A lonely white road winding up through bare Andalusian hills at dusk toward a far city of towers and domes on a hill under a vast sky, one beam of hard light falling on the road ahead; far down the road a single tiny traveller with a pack on his back is seen from behind, walking away. No other people, no faces.

beats.text: So he went to Granada, and began to sell books there.
